description: This file defines the OverlayPanelFactory enum with static methods for creating, animating, presenting, and dismissing overlay panels in a macOS application using AppKit. It acts as a factory and utility class for managing overlay panels and their animations.

methods.name: makePanel
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSPanel with specified properties such as size, level, shadow, and mouse event acceptance.

methods.name: animatePresent
methods.description: Animates a window from a start rect to a target rect with a fade-in effect.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Animates a window's frame to a specified rectangle over a duration.

methods.name: applyFrame
methods.description: Sets the window's frame instantly or with animation based on the parameter.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles the presentation of a window, including initial presentation with animation or immediate if already visible.

methods.name: animateDismiss
methods.description: Animates the dismissal of a window with a fade-out and frame offset effect, then calls a completion handler.

methods.name: animateDismissAndHide
methods.description: Animates dismissing a window and then hides it, executing a callback after.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventMonitor
methods.description: Removes and clears a global event monitor reference.
